conventions.observatory: Las Campanas Observatory, geodetic lon=-70.6920 deg lat=-29.0089 deg height=2281 m
conventions.ephemeris: bundled JPL DE432s short SPK selected explicitly through Astropy
conventions.observed_wavelength: unchanged native LVM air-wavelength detector grid
conventions.detector_projection: integration over exact native detector-pixel boundaries with the measured Gaussian detector LSF
conventions.flux_unit: physical carriers in erg s-1 cm-2 Angstrom-1 per LVM fibre before physical_to_fit_flux_scale
conventions.moon_below_horizon: construct visible carriers at moon altitude 0.01 deg and then apply the learned suppression
conventions.zodiacal_brightness: Leinert B500 surface brightness with the frozen analytic colour and extinction convention
